description: This Java class 'AdminDBUtil' provides database utility methods for managing 'Admin' records, including validation, retrieval, creation, update, and deletion.

classes.name: AdminDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class for database operations related to Admin entities.

methods.name: validateAdmin
methods.description: Validates admin credentials by querying the database with email and password.

methods.name: getAllAdmins
methods.description: Retrieves all admin records from the database.

methods.name: addAdmin
methods.description: Inserts a new admin record into the database.

methods.name: updateAdmin
methods.description: Updates an existing admin's details including image URL.

methods.name: deleteAdmin
methods.description: Deletes an admin record based on AID.

methods.name: updateAdminWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates admin details excluding the image URL.
